steps.what: Find specialised materials for outside reading assignments in the library catalogue and scholarly reference manager {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual course topic and reading purpose
outputs: Located candidate materials with source records

steps.what: Read and select the actual materials for their relevance, level, language, accessibility and representation of the cultures or groups being studied.
outputs: Human-selected reading set and actual source metadata

steps.what: Compile bibliographies by formatting the selected materials, editions and access links into the course reading-list draft {DOCS}.
Check every completed bibliography entry against the actual source or catalogue, including edition, author, translation, stable identifier and student access, and verify the intended course audience.
outputs: Checked exact bibliography and course destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked bibliography version in {DOCS}.
Publish that exact checked bibliography to the verified course audience in the {LMS}.

tasks.design: Use saved catalogue searches and native reference-manager formatting before considering any model. The teacher selects the actual specialised readings and checks every final source and access route. Do not generate plausible references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue searches and manual citation formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches, metadata records and citation-style output.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting appropriate voices, editions and accessible readings.
tasks.human_edge: Scholarly and pedagogical judgment about the reading set.
tasks.altitude: Reading selection stays with the teacher.

evidence.claim: Catalogue searches and native citation formatting can reduce repeated bibliography preparation without establishing source relevance or existence.

assumptions: Conditional E1 allocation with actual manual search and formatting, not a measured baseline. Existing configured tools yield zero saving.

s1 locates actual records and s2 reads materials and produces the selected author, title, edition, year, identifier and access metadata. Missing or conflicting metadata is repaired manually; no free verified source list is assumed.

s4 checks the complete final bibliography, not just identifiers. It supplies ordinary final-version save and publish gates without added self-approval labour. Changes require recheck; both action tails stay fully retained.
research_questions: Can native output preserve translations and editions and resolve all selected sources?

already_counted.description: Source inspection/selection, residual formatting, every-source final check, save and publication remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain citation styles, saved searches and broken access links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography checked against actual sources in s4
Exact bibliography and course audience checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25 x 30% search reduction plus 25 x 80% formatting reduction = 27.5 gross points less 2 upkeep = 25.5; high rounded down to 25. No selection or final source-check saving.

steps.what: Develop the actual cultural-studies research question, methods and evidence base and read the funder's current call in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual research idea and prior work
outputs: Human-developed aims, methods and source pack

steps.what: Obtain the actual collaborator contributions, resource estimates and institutional submission conditions through discussion with the responsible people.
outputs: Actual agreed inputs and unresolved commitments

steps.what: Populate the funder's proposal fields and required attachments in {DOCS} from actual project, contributor and institution records.
inputs: Actual agreed contributor and resource inputs
outputs: Populated proposal structure and factual fields

steps.what: Write grant proposals' narrative sections from the actual aims, methods, contribution agreements and referenced prior work {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual source pack and agreed inputs

loop.purpose: Draft narrative wording from the teacher's actual proposal content
loop.input: Human-written aims and methods, verified references, actual resource inputs and funder headings
loop.output: Draft narrative with source pointers and explicit unresolved fields
loop.check: Teacher verifies each substantive claim, method, representation of communities, resource statement and citation against actual inputs
loop.stop: At most two drafts; unsupported claims, absent agreements or uncertain references remain manual and block submission as appropriate
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle factual fields first; a bounded model can assist variable narrative wording, not create the research design

steps.what: Review and correct the completed proposal for meaning, feasibility, references and actual commitments, obtain any required institutional clearance on that final version, and check the submission destination.
outputs: Checked and authorised exact final proposal package or hold

steps.what: Save the exact checked final proposal package in {DOCS}.
Submit the exact checked proposal to the verified funder destination through the grant application portal {OTHER}, within actual submission authority.
inputs: Destination and actual clearance checked in s5
outputs: Submitted research proposal and native receipt

tasks.design: Configure funder templates in {DOCS}, then use a bounded model only for narrative drafting from the teacher's actual research content. Retain research design, obtaining real commitments and full final review. Submit through the grant application portal {OTHER} only after the final version and required clearances exist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated factual-field entry and narrative rewriting to different funder headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates plus source-bounded narrative drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Research merit, feasibility and responsible representation of participants or communities.
tasks.human_edge: Creating the research and securing real collaborators' agreement.

ambition.what: Support the current external funding application.

tasks.altitude: Research and submission responsibility stay human.

evidence.claim: Templates and source-bounded drafting can reduce repeated grant preparation while research design and final commitments remain human.

assumptions: E1 workload estimates, not measured savings. s1 creates actual aims and methods; s2 obtains actual contributions, effort estimates and conditions. Missing facts are resolved manually, not generated.

s3 uses actual project title, investigator identifiers, contributor roles, resource figures and verified reference metadata. Model access must be permitted for the supplied materials; if not, keep narrative writing manual.

The path assumes the teacher actually has submission authority after required institutional clearance. s5 counts the teacher's review, corrections and clearance coordination after the final package exists. Other officials' own decision labour remains unchanged and outside this role's saving; no clearance is invented or bypassed.

Ordinary s5 final checks gate separate save and submit actions without an extra self-approval stage. Any revision invalidates the applicable clearance and exact-version gates. Acceptance of a funding award or contract is not part of this submission.
research_questions: Can a historical proposal be redrafted without adding unsupported methods, sources or commitments?

already_counted.description: Actual design and commitment gathering, residual field and narrative work, full final review/clearance coordination, save and submit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain funder mappings and monitor source-bounded drafting failures after changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final proposal package checked and cleared in s5
Exact final proposal, actual clearance and submission destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 50% field-entry plus 30 x 30% narrative-work reduction = 19 gross points less 3 upkeep. No research-design, commitment, final review or action-tail saving.

tasks.short: Participate in events and give public research lectures

steps.what: Clarify the actual campus or community event audience, research topic, contribution and timing with the organiser.
Write and check the real contribution confirmation and organiser recipient in {EMAIL}.
Send the exact checked contribution confirmation to the organiser through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact message and recipient checked in s2

steps.what: Develop the actual public lecture outline from the teacher's research, choosing the claims, examples and limitations appropriate to the audience {DOCS}.
Format the actual lecture outline and source references into the presentation document {DOCS}.
Check the completed presentation's research meaning, sources, audience suitability and any disclosure limits.
Save the exact checked presentation version in {DOCS}.
Participate in campus and community events by giving the actual public research lecture and responding to the audience's questions.
outputs: Delivered lecture and real public engagement

tasks.design: Use native presentation styles in {DOCS} for repeated formatting only. The teacher authors the research explanation, checks the complete presentation and delivers the lecture. Keep real event confirmation writing and its send separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual formatting of an already authored lecture outline.
tasks.enabler_now: Native presentation layouts and reference styles.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining research fairly and responding to audience concerns.

ambition.what: Support the existing public lecture contribution.

tasks.altitude: Public contribution remains personal and accountable.

evidence.claim: Native presentation styles can reduce active formatting of human-authored lecture content.

assumptions: E1 allocation for an actual public lecture with presentation preparation, not a measured baseline or generic event assumed to require slides. Existing styles give zero saving.

The teacher produces the actual research outline and references in s4. No free structured lecture, generated examples or new external source is assumed. All substantive writing and audience work remain counted.

s2 checks the real final confirmation; s6 checks the completed presentation. They supply separate exact-version gates for send and save without added self-approval labour. Changes invalidate checks; action tails are fully retained.
The lecture is actual human dialogue, not an automated broadcast. No recording publication, handout transmission or post-event report is assumed; those would need their own real steps and gates.
research_questions: Is any active formatting repeated after the research outline has been authored?

already_counted.description: All coordination, confirmation, substantive lecture writing, residual formatting, final checks, save and public engagement remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain presentation styles after institutional layout changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact event confirmation and organiser recipient checked in s2
Exact completed presentation checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 5 x 40% active formatting reduction = 2 gross points less 0.5 upkeep. No lecture meaning, delivery or action-tail saving.

tasks.short: Incorporate experiential or site-visit course components

steps.what: Design the experiential or site visit component and its connection to the cultural-studies course, including learning aims, student preparation and reflection.
Consult the actual site or community host about feasible activities, access, timing and respectful participation, agreeing the real educational scope.
outputs: Actual agreed educational scope and access conditions

steps.what: Inspect the actual setting or verify its practical arrangements to judge accessibility, suitability and required student support before including the visit.
outputs: Verified arrangements and unresolved suitability issues

steps.what: Write the course activity brief and student instructions in the {LMS}, using the actual learning design, host agreement and verified arrangements.
Check the completed course component and student instructions against actual learning aims, access conditions, host agreement and course audience.
outputs: Checked exact course component and student destination, or hold

steps.what: Save the checked experiential course component in the {LMS}.
Publish the exact checked component and student instructions to the verified course audience in the {LMS}.

tasks.design: Configure a native {LMS} experiential-activity template for existing course fields and fixed headings. The teacher designs the learning, obtains the actual host agreement and verifies the setting. Keep substantive student instructions and full final checks human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated course identifiers and standard activity headings are entered anew.
tasks.still_hard: Learning quality, access and respectful engagement with the actual host.
tasks.human_edge: Designing a worthwhile activity and verifying real conditions.

ambition.what: Support incorporation of the current experiential component.

evidence.claim: Native course-component templates can reduce repeated administrative entry without designing or verifying a site visit.

assumptions: Conditional E1 allocation for an actual site-visit component, not a measured baseline. Already configured fields give zero saving. The 20% writing step retains 80% for new substantive content.

s1 creates actual learning aims; s2 obtains real host conditions; s3 verifies actual arrangements. Course ID and fixed headings are the only reused fields; missing agreements or practical facts remain manual and can hold publication.

This is a no-purchase educational arrangement within existing authority, not a hidden booking, contract, transport order or payment. If those are required, their actual preparation, approval after final terms, sends and records must be separately priced before claiming an expanded saving.

s5 is ordinary completed-component verification and supplies separate exact-version save and publish gates without added self-approval labour. Both tails stay at 1% fully retained. Visit delivery and later reflection assessment are separate work with no saving claimed here.
unknowns: Whether any purchase workflow is required
research_questions: Which activity fields are truly repeated, and can the template preserve site-specific access conditions?

already_counted.description: Full learning design, host dialogue, setting verification, substantive instructions, final checks, save and publication remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain course-component headings and fixed fields after course rollover.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed course component checked in s5
Exact component, student instructions and audience checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 20% fixed-field entry reduction = 4 gross points less 0.5 upkeep. No design, consultation, site verification or action-tail saving.
